title: Absolute indices for determining compactness, separability and number of clusters
abstract: arXiv:2510.13065v3 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Finding "true" clusters in a data set is a challenging problem. Clustering solutions obtained using different models and algorithms do not necessarily provide compact and well-separated clusters or the optimal number of clusters. Cluster validity indices are commonly applied to identify such clusters. Nevertheless, these indices are typically relative, and they are used to compare clustering algorithms or choose the parameters of a clustering algorithm. Moreover, the success of these indices depends on the underlying data structure. This paper introduces novel absolute cluster indices to determine both the compactness and separability of clusters. We define a compactness function for each cluster and a set of neighboring points for cluster pairs. tldr: 本文提出了新的绝对聚类指标，通过定义每个聚类的紧致性函数和聚类对的邻近点集，直接量化聚类的紧致性与可分性，无需依赖相对比较，从而更可靠地确定聚类质量。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces novel absolute cluster indices that quantify compactness and separability directly via a compactness function for each cluster and neighboring point sets for cluster pairs, enabling reliable assessment without relative comparisons.
